Title: [BUG] uable to copy note text in media view 
Body: **Describe the bug**
![Screenshot_20231029-071320.png](https://github.com/vitorpamplona/amethyst/assets/1747287/042d7f8c-1829-4ff6-be16-99cc9110e0ba)

When in media view I would like to save a video or a photo. This is not possible due to no sharing available. 

Workaround is to attempt to copy note text to extract the media url. 

However just an empty content is copied instead of the note text. 

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to Media view (see screenshot above) 
2. Click on three dots and select Copy Text
3. Empty Text is copied to clipboard 

**Expected behavior**
The text of the note including any Media url should be copied to clipboard 

**Video and Screenshots**
Empty Text has been copied 
![Screenshot_20231029-071728.png](https://github.com/vitorpamplona/amethyst/assets/1747287/0b5bcb4c-65f5-4c1a-8c56-b39fcfbf03da)

 - Phone Brand/Model  Pixel 7 Pro: 
 - Android Version  34

Title: List of entries does not refresh after removing search query after deleting all results
Body: ### Version

v2.1.2

### Source

F-Droid

### Vault encryption

No

### Device

Pixel 6

### Android version

Android 13

### ROM

GrapheneOS

### Steps to reproduce

1. Add at least two 2FA entries to the app. Let's name them "Foo" and "Bar".
2. Use the search function to search for "Foo".
3. Press-and-hold the entry for "Foo". Use the kebab menu (three vertical dots) to delete the entry. Confirm the deletion.
4. Remove the search filter for "Foo" by pressing the "x" next to the search filter.


### What do you expect to happen?

After step 3, I expected to see the message "Showing 0 entries"; as if I had only added "Bar" in step 1, and then searched for "Foo".

After step 4, I expected to see the "Bar" entry that was added in step 1.


### What happens instead?

After step 3, the list of entries contains only the placeholder "No entries found", with an explanation of how I can add an entry. This is distinct from the "Showing 0 entries" message; the "No entries found" placeholder and explanation are normally only shown when the user has never added an entry or has deleted all entries.

After step 4, the same "No entries found" placeholder is shown, even though there is no search filter, and "Bar" is still in there.

**Attempted mitigations:**
* Pressing the phone's back button to close the search filter input does not resolve the issue.
* Fully closing and re-opening the app resolves the issue.
* Adding _three_ entries, "Foo A", "Foo B", and "Bar", then searching for "Foo", then deleting "Foo A", then removing the filter _does not_ trigger the bug.
* Adding _three_ entries, "Foo A", "Foo B", and "Bar", then searching for "Foo", then deleting both "Foo A" and "Foo B", then removing the filter _does_ trigger the bug.

### Log

_No response_

Title: Accuracy Window - inconsistent Units of Measure
Body: **Bug Description**
In the ACCURACY window, the **Your...** (position) continues to use decimal degrees and metres when the user sets degrees & decimal minutes and feet in **Settings**, even though the accuracy data at the bottom of the window is expressed in feet.

**To Reproduce**
In Settings: 
1) change the **Coordinate format** from decimal degrees to degrees decimal minutes
2) change **Preferred distance units** to Feet
3) change **Preferred speed units** to Miles per hour

**Expected behaviour**
The users settings to be used throughout the App

**Observed behaviour**
As above

**App, Device and Android version:** 
GPSTest Version 3.8.3
Acer Iconia One 10 B3-A40
Android 7.0 (Nougat)
Google Play (and Gmail) not used

Title: Floating action button doesn't reset visibility after changing filters
Body: The Floating Action Button in Aegis is shown when the users scroll up and will hide when the users scrolls down. In some cases (when switching filters for example) the EntryListView's height will change so scrolling becomes unavailable. If the user decides to switch filters after the FAB hid, there is no easy way to get the FAB back because the user can't scroll. To make it more clear, here are the steps to reproduce.

1. Open the app (and unlock the vault when encrypted)
1. Make sure all your filters are default and you have enough tokens saved so you can scroll
2. Scroll down so the FAB hides
3. Change the group filter (or search for entries) so you are left with only a few entries
4. The FAB is now hidden and there is no easy way to get it back

A simple way to fix this is to reset visibility after changing filters or search queries.

Title: Search transactions using subcategories does not work.
Body: **Describe the bug**
Search transactions using subcategories does not work.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to home
2. Click on search icon
3. Scroll down to category and choose subcategory (example income->salary), search
4. See no result

**Expected behavior**
Search result for transactions regarding subcategory 

**Screenshots**
![Screenshot_20231230-142634.png](https://github.com/moneymanagerex/android-money-manager-ex/assets/3205448/e0ed3481-ae46-44ce-8ad8-f86bf0ee34bc)


**Device Information:**
 - Device: Motorola Moto g100
 - OS: android 12
 - Cloud Storage: not relevant
 - App Version: 2023.12.27

**Additional context**
If using first level category, search working (and result all transactions belong to category and subcategory)

Title: Location changes back to first location when saving updated weather data main source
Body: ### Steps to reproduce

1. Download app from F-Droid.
2. Deny location permission.
3. Add 2 or more locations using location search.
4. Select a location (that isn't the first in the list) from the Locations screen.
5. Scroll to the bottom, and update the weather source. (I flip flopped between Open-Meteo and AccuWeather.)
6. Save change
7. Notice the location has changed from the selected location to the location appearing first on the Locations screen.

### Expected behavior

The currently viewed location should stay the same. (Maybe even scroll position.)

### Actual behavior

The user is taken to the location appearing first on the Locations screen.

### Weather source used

Switched between Open-Meteo and AccuWeather 

### Breezy Weather version

4.6.9-beta

### Android version

GrapheneOS - Android 14

### Device

Pixel 5a 5G

### Other details

_No response_

- [X] I wrote my request in English, and any screenshot I attached are also in English (language can be changed from Settings > Appearance), unless my issue only happens with a specific language

Title: Can't enter negative sign for lat/lon/alt in Accuracy view
Body: **Describe the bug**
In Accuracy view, if you type a negative sign into the latitude, longitude, or altitude text boxes, nothing happens (no negative signs are added).

I think the changes in https://github.com/barbeau/gpstest/issues/389 broke this.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to Accuracy view
2. Tap on fields for latitude, longitude, or altitude
3. Type `-`

**Expected behavior**
`-` should appear in the text box

**Observed behavior**
Nothing appears in the text box

**App, Device and Android version:** 

Samsung Galaxy S8+ with Android 9

Title: [BUG]: Card remains selected even after unselecting it
Body: ### Checked for duplicates?

- [X] This issue is not a duplicate

### What are the steps to reproduce this bug?

- In the Card Browser, select a card.
- Then, select another card and unselect the previous one.

### Expected behaviour

The previous card gets unselected.

### Actual behaviour

The previous card remains selected (as indicated by the selected card count at the top). If you scroll down and then up again, both cards would even show the checkmarks.

### Debug info

```text
2.17 alpha 10
```


### (Optional) Anything else you want to share?

_No response_

### Research

- [X] I am reporting a bug specific to AnkiDroid (Android app)
- [X] I have checked the [manual](https://ankidroid.org/docs/manual.html) and the [FAQ](https://github.com/ankidroid/Anki-Android/wiki/FAQ) and could not find a solution to my issue
- [X] (Optional) I have confirmed the issue is not resolved in the latest alpha release ([instructions](https://docs.ankidroid.org/manual.html#betaTesting))

Title: Error Parsing link
Body: **Describe the bug**
Error: org.apache.harmony.xml.ExpatParser$PaseException: At line 1 column 0 no element found.

Handy Reader version 0.19.11

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Add http://www.rsbnetwork.com/category/news/feed/  as RSS feed
2. Attempt to fetch article
3. See error

Both https and http versions giveback an error, http version is the error I mentioned, while https version only says that the website is unreachable.

**Expected behavior**
Expected to fetch the articles from the RSS feed correctly.

Body: Steps:

1. Fill all fields, amount is 0,12
1. Switch to item txn
1. Note amount still being 0,12
1. Save

Actual:

An item txn with amount 0 is saved

Expected:

An item txn with amount 12 is saved after the amount field is reformatted to 12 upon switching to item

Title: [Bug] Editing a taken dose time in 24H format is mapping to wrong AM/PM time&day on select
Body: **Describe the bug**
When i edit the time of a dose already taken the time i select on a 24H wheel gets mapped to the wrong AM or PM time&day.
This happens when pressing OK in the time selection popup. The time i selected is not the same as the new time displayed before saving. Example: My selection of 22:30 is converted to 10:30, either on the same or the next day. When i press on the time again to fix this, the selection popup and the value in the app seem even more out of sync due to time conversions, i guess.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Have a phone with a system clock set to use the 24H format
2. edit the time of a taken dose AND actually change the time on the time wheel! (if you have trouble to reproduce this, change the time over the 12 o'clock mark)
3. See the wrong time and sometimes day before pressing the checkmark to save. On save the wrong time&day will be saved, not the correct one. This suggests it is more than just a display bug.

**Expected behavior**
The time i actually selected gets displayed and saved, without changing the day when i did'nt touch the day.

**Smartphone (please complete the following information):**
 - Device: Motorola EDGE 20
 - OS: Android 11
 - Version: 1.6.1
 - Build Location: F-Droid release

### Source

Google Play

### Vault encryption

Yes (with biometric unlock)

### Device

Samsung S21

### Android version

Android 14

_No response_

1) Click 3 dots to open the options

All tokens to be imported with correctly including account name.

br_content:
Title: Title of password entry is not shown in header after new entry is saved
Body: When a new password entry is created and saved (in the new password entry view) the title in the header is not updated and still shows "(no title)".

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Click on "+" button
2. Insert a value for the title
3. Click on save icon
4. After successfully saving the save icon is hidden but the title of the password entry is not updated

**Expected behavior**
After saving the title in the password view is updated with the title of the currently opened and saved entry.

Title: [BUG]: display order bug for notes
Body: ### Checked for duplicates?

- [X] This issue is not a duplicate

### What are the steps to reproduce this bug?

Go to "card browser" then "options" and under "toggle cards/notes" select "notes". Go to "change display order" and choose another option.

### Expected behaviour

The display order should stay as set, like when "cards" is selected in "toggle cards/notes."

### Actual behaviour

When you select "notes", it automatically sets the display order to "by created time" oldest to newest. If you choose another option it doesn't change except by pressing "by created time" again to flip the direction.  This only works until you exit the app or add a new note, and it then flips to oldest to newest again.

❌ 为何这是一个 Bug：
预期行为：

在用户点击 "Test" 分组后，应只显示该分组下的条目；

删除操作应该只针对 当前可见（被过滤出来）并选中的条目；

因此删除确认框中应只出现 Test 分组中的那一条（A）。

实际行为：

筛选后仍然保留了之前多选的上下文（A+B），并将两条都加入了删除操作中；

这违背了筛选视图的隔离性原则；

用户可能以为当前只会删除可见条目（A），但其实 B 也会被删除，属于 意图与行为不一致 的 UX 问题。

Title: HTML entities in feed titles not decoded 
Body: **Describe the bug**
A feed which has an HTML entity, such as `'`, in its "link rel alternate" title should have that entity decoded.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Attempt to add feed https://garyodernichts.blogspot.com/, with load type set to RSS
2. See choice of two feeds, Atom and RSS
3. Note that the feed names are displayed as "Gary`'`s hacking stuff - Atom" or "Gary`'`s hacking stuff - RSS"

**Expected behavior**
The feed name should be displayed as "Gary's hacking stuff - Atom" or "Gary's hacking stuff - RSS"

**Screenshots**
![Screenshot_20220609-202807](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2512915/172929475-2461c5a0-8b74-4ef6-8ef0-a7b4673d060d.png)

Handy NR version 0.17.1

**Additional context**
Note that if you add the feeds with their direct URLs, i.e. https://garyodernichts.blogspot.com/feeds/posts/default or https://garyodernichts.blogspot.com/feeds/posts/default?alt=rss the problem doesn't occur, so the problem is when looking up the "link rel alternate" things from the webpage HTML, I think.

Body: Steps to reproduce:

1. Go to diary record for 2018-07-15
2. Run custom calendar. It shows July. That is expected.
3. Tap left arrow. Instead of June custom calendar will switch to November.
4. Afterwards next and previous buttons work as expected.

br_content:
Title: Different currencies are summed together incorrectly

Body:
Steps to reproduce:

Create two accounts with different currencies (e.g. USD and Chinese Yuan).

Set the initial balance of each account to 200 in their respective currencies.

Go back to the home screen.

Notice that the total balance is shown as "$400.00", combining both USD and CNY without conversion.

Expected behavior:
Only accounts with the same currency should be summed together, or there should be a clear currency conversion before showing a combined total.

br_content: Title: [BUG]: "Set due date" setting in App bar buttons also controls the display of "Reset progress" Body: ### Checked for duplicates? - [X] This issue is not a duplicate ### Does it also happen in the desktop version? - [X] This bug does not occur in the latest version of Anki ### What are the steps to reproduce this bug? - In `Settings → Appearance → App bar buttons`, choose "Disabled" for "Set due date". - Go to the reviewer and open the menu. - See that it doesn't show the "Reschedule" option and, thus, the "Set due date" and "Reset progress" options. - In the settings, now choose "Menu only". - Return to the reviewer and see that the "Reschedule" option appears. ### Expected behaviour The "Set due date" setting should only control the display of the "Set due date" option. If it controls the display of both, the setting should be named as "Reschedule". ### Actual behaviour Described along with the reproduction steps. ### Debug info ```text 2.19 alpha4 ``` ### (Optional) Anything else you want to share? As a side note, I feel that if sufficient space is available in the menu, it doesn't make sense to have a separate menu for "Set due date" and "Reset progress". Shifting those options to the main menu will save the users one tap whenever they want to use "Set due date" or "Reset progress". ### Research - [X] I am reporting a bug specific to AnkiDroid (Android app) - [X] I have checked the [manual](https://ankidroid.org/docs/manual.html) and the [FAQ](https://github.com/ankidroid/Anki-Android/wiki/FAQ) and could not find a solution to my issue - [X] (Optional) I have confirmed the issue is not resolved in the latest alpha release ([instructions](https://docs.ankidroid.org/manual.html#betaTesting))

Title: Can't change group if the last one is deleted
Body: <!-- Please read the [bug reports section of the contribution
guidelines](/CONTRIBUTING.md#bug-reports) before submitting an issue. -->

###### Info

* __Version__: 2.0-beta1
* __Source__: Google Play
* __Vault encrypted__: Yes (with biometric unlock)
* __Device__: OnePlus 6
* __Android version and ROM__: 10

###### Steps to reproduce

1. Make sure that there are **no** groups and >2 entries (the group button on top is not visible)
2. Put one entry in a new group
3. Filter for that group (one entry is shown)
4. While the filter is active edit the entry and remove the group
5. No entries are shown and the group button is also hidden

###### What do you expect to happen?

All group filters should be removed if there are no groups left.

###### What happens instead?

The group filter remains even if there are no groups left. There is no way to reset the filter other than restarting the app.

Title: BUG: Multimedia Option Open Twice When Bottom Sheet is Opened Twice
Body: I reported this before in https://github.com/ankidroid/Anki-Android/issues/17201 and @criticalAY tried to fix it in https://github.com/ankidroid/Anki-Android/pull/17239

I think I have identified how to properly reproduce this so I'm opening this new issue.
___

## Steps

1. Open the Add screen.
2. For any field, open the multimedia bottom sheet.
3. Now, close it.
4. Now open it again and select an option.

## Behaviour

When you've selected a file and clicked OK, the files app open again. Similar behaviour with other options too. With record audio, I'm prompted to record audio once again.

I understand that the bug report will be dismissed otherwise.** - [X] This issue contains only one bug. - [X] I have read and understood the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/FossifyOrg/File-Manager/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md). ### Affected app version 1.0.0 ### Affected Android/Custom ROM version Android 14 ### Affected device model Samsung A54 ### How did you install the app? GitHub releases ### Steps to reproduce the bug 1. Go to the Storage Analysis tab 2. Tap on the arrow to display the files types categories of the storage (internal or SD card) 3. Open one of the categories (e.g. videos). The "sort by" icon is visible at the top of the screen [screenshot 1]. By tapping on the three dots, two items are shown [screenshot 2]. 4. Tap on the search bar 5. While the cursor is in the search bar, tap on the three dots : now the "sort by" function is shown with the 2 previous items [screenshot 3]. 6. Tap anywhere on the screen 7. Tap on the back arrow to stop using the search bar [screenshot 4]. ### Expected behavior The "sort by" icon should remain visible. ### Actual behavior The "sort by" icon disappears and the corresponding item is no longer shown by tapping on the three dots. Closing the tab which is in use (Videos in my example) fixes the problem. Otherwise, the "sort by" function is still usable by tapping on the search bar and then on the three dots, but this does not make the icon reappear. For the icon to appear again, you must press on the three dots (normally there are just 2 items). Then tap anywhere on the screen, then on the search bar and finally on the back arrow : the "sort by" icon is now visible again. ### Screenshots/Screen recordings screenshot 1: screenshot 2: screenshot 3: screenshot 4: ### Additional information _No response_

Title: [BUG]:  Symbol "_" in search text is ignored
Body: ### Checked for duplicates?

- [X] This issue is not a duplicate

### Does it also happen in the desktop version?

- [X] This bug does not occur in the latest version of Anki

### What are the steps to reproduce this bug?

1. Open the Card brower page
2. Add the cards containing the special symbol "-"
3.  Only search the "-" 
4. The cards that do not contain this symbol will also be searched


### Expected behaviour

Cards with corresponding symbols should be presented during search

### Actual behaviour

Symbol "_" in search text is ignored, but the symbol "-" is working.

### Debug info

```text
AnkiDroid Version = 2.18.0 (464cf290cc77c3f2c562cb03b408b78a13be261b)

Backend Version = 0.1.38-anki24.04.1 (24.04.1 ccd9ca1a8309b80bcb50ddc5d99c7ce63440bce9)

Android Version = 8.1.0 (SDK 27)

ProductFlavor = full

Manufacturer = Google

Model = Android SDK built for x86

Hardware = ranchu

Webview User Agent = Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 8.1.0; Android SDK built for x86 Build/OSM1.180201.037; wv) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/69.0.3497.100 Mobile Safari/537.36

ACRA UUID = aca1a327-477a-43a2-9e70-18a001fd3e0b

FSRS Enabled = false

Crash Reports Enabled = true
```


### (Optional) Anything else you want to share?

_No response_

### Research

- [X] I am reporting a bug specific to AnkiDroid (Android app)
- [X] I have checked the [manual](https://ankidroid.org/docs/manual.html) and the [FAQ](https://github.com/ankidroid/Anki-Android/wiki/FAQ) and could not find a solution to my issue

Title: Misleading "PIN error" when internet connection is disabled
Body: ### Description

On someone else's Android phone with the latest Blockstream Green app I have seen that they received "PIN error" but it was actually a missing connection (WiFi and data were turned off, after turning WiFi on, the error disappeared).

<!-- brief description of the bug -->

### Version

Will write more details when I manage to reproduce the error.

<!-- commit id or version number -->

### Steps to reproduce

 1. While connected to internet: Set up a testnet wallet. Set PIN to 123456.
 2. Disconnect from internet. "Stop" the app (in the app history swipe it away.)
 3. Turn on the app. Try to log into the testnet wallet.

<!-- if you can reliably reproduce the bug, list here the steps  -->

### Expected behaviour

Something like `Error: Unable to connect.`

<!-- description of the expected behavior -->

### Actual behaviour

`PIN error`

<!-- explain what happened instead of the expected behaviour -->

### Screenshots

<!-- screenshots if gui related, drag and drop to add to the issue -->

### Device or machine

The device I saw it on was some recent Samsung Android smartphone.
<!-- device/machine used, operating system -->

Title: FTP server cannot be used without WiFi, and there is no prompt
Body: **Describe the bug**
When I use the data network, I can't turn on the FTP server, and there is no prompt. I can only see that the start button is gray. After trying it out, I found that this feature can only be used on WiFi networks.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Install and open AmazeFileManager
2. Open menu bar
3. Scroll down to 'FTP server'
4. Click on 'FTP server'
5. Unable to click the start button

**Expected behavior**
Users should be prompted to turn on WiFi when there is no WiFi network, otherwise they don't know why they can't use FTP server

**Screenshots**
![ezgif com-video-to-gif (3)](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/15941953/86330075-b6abd280-bc79-11ea-9fb7-4278e97de57e.gif)

**Smartphone (please complete the following information):**
 - Device: galaxy a6s
 - OS: Android 8.1.0
 - Rooted: No
 - Version: v3.4.3

Body: ### Checked for duplicates?

- [X] This issue is not a duplicate

### Does it also happen in the desktop version?

- [ ] This bug does not occur in the latest version of Anki

### What are the steps to reproduce this bug?

1. Create a cloze card (card 1)
2. Create another card (card 2)
3. Add another cloze to the first card's note (card 3)
4. View the cards in card browser while display order is set to "by created time"

### Expected behaviour

card 1, card 2, card 3 appears in order.

### Actual behaviour

card 1 and card 3 which are siblings of each other are grouped together.

### Debug info

```text
2.19alpha8
```

_No response_

Title: First time setup does not require confirming password if "show password" box is checked
Body: First time setup does not require confirming password if "show password" box is checked

###### Info

* __Version__: 1.14
* __Source__: Google Play
* __Vault encrypted:__ Yes (with biometric unlock)
* __Device:__ Samsung Galaxy S10e, SM-G970U
* __Android version and ROM:__ Android 10, stock ROM

###### Steps to reproduce

1. Fresh install of app
2. Enable biometric unlock (fingerprint). Note: I did not test this without enabling biometric unlock
3. Type a password and click "show password"
4. Click enter or next without confirming password

###### What do you expect to happen?

A prompt for confirming the password would be expected here.

###### What happens instead?

No prompt, user is taken directly to the main page of the app

br_content:
Title: Saving of end date is incorrect if end time is set afterwards
Body: **Description of the bug**
When setting a new contact, if an end time is set after setting an end date, the internals modify the end date previously set. Despite showing the correct end date, saving and opening the contact again show an incorrect end date. This does not happen when the order followed is Begin date - Begin time - End date.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Create new contact or event
2. Set a begin date
3. Set an end date different from the begin date
4. Set a begin time
5. Save the entry and edit it. The end date is not the original one.

**Additional information**
When editing the contact/event, the problem does not appear. Therefore, it is only a problem in `NewContactActivity` and `NewEventActivity`.

Title: Latest version (2024.02.26) errors on editing 
Body: **Describe the bug**
I updated to the latest version but if I tried to edit a current transaction it errors and does not save.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to any current transaction and try to change the payee
2. Multiple errors when saving - cannot save. Have to revert.
3. Adding a new transaction is not affected 

**Expected behavior**
Should be able to edit old or recent transactions 

**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

**Device Information:**
 - Device: [ Google pixel 7a]
 - OS: [e.g. Android 13]
 - Cloud Storage: [ Google drive]
 - App Version: [2024.02.26]

**Additional context**
Reverted back to version  2024.02.15 as this version does not have the issue.

Menu, search, backup menu inflated are hidden.

Menu, search, backup menu inflated should be shown after switching the backups.

Title: Tapping the Donate button does nothing
Body: **Describe the bug**
The 'Donate' button on the About screen  in 2024.12.22 (1054), 
2024.12.19 (1053) and earlier does nothing.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Tap the AMMEX menu.
2. Tap on 'About'.
3. Tap the 'Donate' button.
4. Nothing happens.

**Expected behavior**
I would expect that the Donate button would open a screen that allows you to make a donation to the AMMEX project.


**Device Information:**
 - Device: Samsung S22 Ultra
 - OS: Android 14
 - Storage: Phone storage + OneDrive
 - Synchronization: N/A
 - Encrypted: Yes with password
 - Security: Actived with passcode or fingerprint 
 - App Version: 2024.12.22 (1054)

**Additional context**
N/A

Title: [BUG] Copy text on an edited post copies the original text to clipboard 
Body: **Describe the bug**
Copy text on an edited post copies the original text to clipboard instead of the (new) edited text

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Create a new post
2. Edit the post and add new text
3. Copy text
4. Copied text is the original note text and not the new edited text

**Expected behavior**
Copied text should be the new edited content

**Device (please complete the following information):**
 - Phone Brand/Model Pixel 7 Pro
 - Android Version 34
 - App Version 89.7 google play

Title: Biometric or password during setup, broken? Results in wrong password everytime!
Body: ###### Info
I just downloaded the app from the android store, during the setup I choose biometric and set a password.
However, the problem is every time I try to unlock it says wrong password! For testing I choose **a1** as the password.
My fingerprint does not work either.
Same problem occurs if I only choose to encrypt with a password.
But if choose none from the start, and then once I'm in the app choose to protect it with a password, it works.

* __Version__: 1.2
* __Source__: Google Play
* __Vault encrypted:__ Yes
* __Device:__ OnePlus5
* __Android version and ROM:__ 10, Stock

###### Steps to reproduce

1. Clean install or clear the storage of the app.
2. Start the app.
3. In the setup choose Biometric and enter a password, I took **a1** for test
4. Once you enter the app close it.
5. Start the app again, and try to unlock it. Entering **a1** will result in wrong password!

###### What do you expect to happen?

The app to be unlocked with my password chosen during the setup.

###### What happens instead?

Wrong password instead.

###### Log

```
No log
```

Title: [BUG] Issue with changing language in Settings: a mix of languages
Body: **Describe the bug**
Changing language in settings results in mixed languages in the Settings page

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to Settings
2. Click on Language
3. Change it to another 100% translated language like Swedish
4. Go back to Settings
5. Change back language to English
6. Go back to Settings

**Expected behavior**
All settings text in english

**Actual Behaviour**
A mix of English and Swedish

Title: [BUG] Non-english hashtags are not clickable and followable
Body: **Describe the bug**
Impossible to open non-english hashtags to follow them.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Post message with hashtag in english: `#test of hashtags`
2. Click and follow it
3. Post message with hashtag in russian (for example): `#тест хэштегов`
4. You can't click and follow this hashtag

**Expected behavior**
Clickable and followable non-english (probably non ASCII) hashtags.

**Screenshot**
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/46797839/231465916-3b72c1ef-4b4d-4941-926b-49cf5414a971.png)


**Device:**
 - Device: Google Pixel 6
 - Android 13
 - App Version [e.g. v0.20.3]: v0.29.2

**Bounty (in Bitcoin sats) offered for a solution**
35000 sats

Title: No return path after tapping on ℹ️ while adding a custom search engine
Body:
Steps to reproduce
Open Settings > Search > Installed search engines > + Add another search engine
Add a name "Test"
Optionally, type anything for the Search string
Tap on the ℹ️ in the top-right
A SUMO page opens
Press back
Expected behavior
I am back to where I left off while adding a search engine

Actual behavior
Dropped to the main page, custom search form data is lost

Device information
Android device: Google Pixel, Android 9.0
Focus version: 7.0 (Build #322461206 🦎 62.0.20180829133835)

Filter on downloaded episodes not updated after deletion
Checklist

I have used the search function to see if someone else has already submitted the same bug report.

I will describe the problem with as much detail as possible.

If the bug only to occurs with a certain podcast, I will include the URL of that podcast.
System info
App version: 2.0.1

App source: F-Droid

Android version: LineageOS 17.1 (Android 10)

Device model: OnePlus 6, Galaxy S4

Bug description
Steps to reproduce:

Download an episode of any podcast
Go to the list of episodes, filter on « Downloaded »
Notice the list is correctly filtered to the downloaded episode
Long press the episode and choose « Delete ».
Expected behaviour:
The deleted episode should be removed live from the list filtered on « Downloaded ».

Current behaviour:
The episode stays in the view although it’s not downloaded anymore.
It requires applying the filter again for the view to update.

First occurred: This is a regression of 2.0.1 vs. the 1.8.x series

Title: Suggstion check box inverted.
Body: Editor version 1.35.
Installed from F-Droid.
Device Xiaomi Mi8.
Android 9
Firmware: LineageOS 16.0-20190509-NIGHTLY-dipper

Steps to reproduce:
1. Open Editor.
2. Set settings check box for "Suggestion" marked.
3. Close Editor.
4. Open file from another application (X-Plore, OMN) by the Editor
5. Enter to edit mode by tapping pencil icon

At this state I expect suggestion above keyboard at typing time.
There is no suggestion.
If open settings suggestion check box marked. 
If tap this check box twice - suggestion appear.

But, if leave sugggestion settings disabled (check box not marked) and don't touch the settings next time input suggestion operate...

Another words explanation: suggestion settings stored in inverted state but if changed during edit session operate corresponding tick mark till session closed.

Title: Widget: Notes List widget has unexpected behavior after logout
Body:
Expected
If I log out of the app after adding a Notes List Widget to my device home screen, I expect to see the prompt "Log in to use widget" and see the welcome screen when I tap the widget.

Observed
Right after I log out of the widget, I see the prompt "Log in to use widget" but when I tap it a new note is opened. After that, the widget is blank (no login prompt).

Also, if I resize the widget while logged out of the app, when the widget is large enough the new note button will appear.

Reproduced
Log in to the app.
Add the notes list widget to the device home screen.
Confirm the notes list widget works as expected (opening a note in the list or creating a new note).
Log out of the app.
Confirm the notes list widget shows the "Log in to use widget" message as expected.
Tap on the notes list widget and notice that it opens a new note in the note editor, instead of taking you to the login screen.

Motorola	moto e5 play	8.1.0	2.5-rc-1

Title: Block Cookies Option is not following Language Selection 
Body:
Steps to reproduce
Open the settings menu.

Go to privacy and security.

Scroll down to the Cookies and Site Data/Block Cookies and observe the selection.

Return to the settings menu.

Click on the language and select a language other than current language.

Repeat the 2nd and 3rd steps, and observe the Block Cookies.

Expected behavior
The option chosen in Block Cookies is shown in Current Language selected by User. 

Actual behavior
The Option chosen by the user is not showing in the language selected rather in Previous Language selected by user.

Device information
Android device: 8.0.0
Focus version: 7.0 (Build #222281207 🦎 62.0.20180813190114)

br_content:
Title: Editor - Publish confirmation dialog shown on Save action
Body:
Expected behavior
When I edit a local draft (a draft created while offline) and I click on SAVE action the draft is uploaded to the server.

Actual behavior
When I edit a local draft (a draft created while offline) and I click on SAVE action a "Ready to publish? Keep editing / Publish now" dialog is shown. If I click on "publish now" action on the dialog the post gets actually published.

Steps to reproduce the behavior
turn airplane mode ON
start a draft, give it a title, some content
exit the editor and observe it's saved as Local Drafts
open it again
edit the title or content
tap on SAVE (navigation bar)
observe the "Ready to publish? Keep editing / Publish immediately" dialog is shown
Tested on [device], Android [version], WPAndroid [version]
Emulator Android 9

Title: Unhiding hidden files does not show the file (requires a refresh)
Body:
Expected behavior

The file removed from the hidden files list should be immediately visible in the browser.

Actual behavior

The file is not immediately visible. The file is only visible when the user manually triggers a refresh of the current file view.

Steps to reproduce

Select a file.
Tap "Hide".
Tap "Hidden Files" from top right context menu.
Tap "x" on the file to remove from hidden files list.
Tap "Cancel".

Title: Renaming tag to existing tag on the same note results in wrong notes count and duplicate tags on note 
Body:
Expected
When I rename a tag to an existing tag, I expect the tag to be de-duped everywhere. (No duplicate tags or notes count.)

Observed
When I rename a tag to an existing tag, it is de-duped correctly in the tags list (a duplicate tag isn't created). However, if both tags were used on the same note, the notes count for the tag is erroneously increased by 1 and that tag appears twice on that note.

Reproduced
Create a new note.
Add two tags to the note (e.g. tag1 and tag2).
Open the navigation drawer.
Tap "Edit" next to "Tags."
Tap one of the tags you just added (e.g. tag2).
Rename that tag to the other tag on the note (e.g. rename tag2 to tag1).
Notice that a duplicate tag is not created, but the notes count for the other tag (e.g. tag1) increases by 1 even though that note was already included in the count.
Open the note again and notice it now has two identical tags (e.g. tag1 and tag1).

Device Make: Motorola
Device Model: moto e5 play
Android Version: 8.1.0
Simplenote Version: 2.9-rc-1

Bug Report: Preview Returns to Wrong Card After Editing

App: AnkiDroid

Component: Card Browser → Preview → Edit Note

Steps to Reproduce:

Open Card Browser (e.g. showing deck A)

Switch to another deck (e.g. B)

Select multiple cards (e.g. cards 1, 2, 3)

Open "Preview" from the options menu

Tap "Edit note" on one card, make a change, then tap "Save"

Expected:
Return to the preview of the edited card (from deck B)

Actual:
Returned to a different card from a different deck (e.g. back to deck A)

br_content:
Title: Adding new cards while reviewing does not update counters
Body: 
Some times cause negative count of remaining cards to review.
Reproduction Steps
Open a deck that is below the new card limit
While reviewing, add a new card
Keep reviewing
Expected Result
The new card counter (blue) should be increased as soon as the new card is added.

Actual Result
The new card counter is not increased and will eventually become negative.

Debug info
AnkiDroid Version = 2.12.1

Android Version = 10

ACRA UUID = 89032829-485f-4afd-a966-61ad635fd68c

Title: [Bug] In languages other than English, the latter half of the gesture-triggered action menu causes malfunction
Body:
Reproduction Steps
In Settings - AnkiDroid - Language, select a language other than English, e.g. German, French, Japanese, Chinese simplified.
Then, in the language,

Select Settings - Gestures - Enable gestures.

Tap Swipe up.

Tap Bury note in the menu.

Strictly speaking, to make sure, tap the item whose string should correspond to Bury note.

e.g.
Tap Notiz aufschieben
Tap Enterre la note
Tap ノートを延期
Tap 隐藏笔记

Swipe up on the study screen.

Expected Result
The next card is displayed.

Then, if you select English in Language, and re-open the Swipe up action menu, you see Bury note selected, of course.

Actual Result
The learning is aborted, and the home screen (the Decks screen) is displayed.

Then, if you select English in Language, and re-open the Swipe up action menu, you see Abort learning selected.

Debug info
Ver.2.14.0

The upper 10 items in the menu (the items above the blue line in the following image) work properly.

In languages other than English and Japanese, the string which should correspond to Card info doesn't exist.

(In Japanese, it didn't either, but I added it on November 8. The Japanese string which should correspond to Lookup expression has gone missing instead.)

Instead of the string which should correspond to Card info, the string which should do to Tag note actually correspond to Card info. In other words, the translated string for Tag note has slid up to the position of Card info.

This "sliding up by one step" continues until the item whose string should correspond to Page Down, i.e. until the third item from the bottom (the item on the green line in the image).

The second item from the bottom, whose string also correspond to Page Down, works properly, or the item hasn't been translated (e.g. in German).

This discordance has originally occurred on Crowdin for some reason.
